It also has the lowest disagreement (0.111) with the capture, suggesting the most reliable speaking-state decisions. The comparison with capture shows a positive delta in both MUSIQ and BRISQUE, indicating quality improvement.

The spatial_nlm candidate demonstrates the highest MUSIQ score (16.17) and lowest BRISQUE score (40.22), indicating the best appearance quality among the three. Comparisons with the capture show no disagreement and a significant improvement in quality metrics. All speaking inspections for spatial_nlm indicate 'not_speaking' across the entire duration, which is consistent with the visual evidence and quality metrics.
